description: Open CASCADE's own STEP of primitive/box converted to B-splines (occt_step.py --nurbs), every face a NURBS surface, cut by the box [19,14,4]–[21,16,6] inside it: the boolean classifies the tool's faces against the part by a ray, which crosses the part's NURBS faces through their Bézier patches (plan ray-fire step 1), and the cavity is cut — a solid of two shells, held to Open CASCADE's. Shrunk from the battery of real/nist-ftc-07 and real/nist-ftc-10, whose every cut and drill met the ray's old refusal on a NURBS face
